metadata.source_vintage: London Wards (2025), as labelled by the GLA service
metadata.geography: Electoral wards, grouped using the publisher-provided la_gss_code; not informal neighbourhood boundaries
metadata.projection: Mercator, fitted separately to each borough
metadata.simplification: ArcGIS maxAllowableOffset=0.00005 degrees; six-decimal input and two-decimal SVG paths
metadata.attribution: Contains Ordnance Survey and National Statistics data, Crown copyright and database right.
metadata.caveat: Display boundaries only. No ward-level housing, price, migration or investment figures are inferred from borough averages.
